ui_bugs.issue: Empty Group headers still render when all Row children evaluate to null. In Test v4 workflow (empty phase1 dict) the section shows 14 uppercase group titles (MEDICAL ASSESSMENT / EXTRAORAL / INTRAORAL / RADIOGRAPHIC / etc.) with zero field rows underneath. Root cause: Group.tsx uses React.Children.toArray(children).filter(Boolean) which does NOT filter out <Row/> elements that render null via their internal `if (!value) return null` guard — the elements themselves are truthy, only their rendered output is null. Fix suggestion: change Row to be a plain function (not a component) that returns null OR let Group pass explicit `label,value` pairs and skip empties before creating elements. Reference: /app/frontend/components/ZygomaPterygoidPhase1Review.tsx:63-73 (Group) and :52-61 (Row).
